title: Self-Perception: A view into the mind of Self-Imaging
author: Hunter Duval
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bavwie7e

steps.title: Choose Population
steps.instruction: Select an unbiased population, ensuring the group is not known for being over or under-confident.

steps.title: Set Up Questions
steps.instruction: Develop the questions to be asked of the subjects and determine how these questions pertain to the experiment.

steps.title: Collect Data
steps.instruction: Gather responses from the population using the selected questions.

substeps.instruction: Ask the population the selected questions and record their responses, or
Have the population take a survey containing the selected questions.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Interpret the resulting data to determine what the numbers mean, specifically identifying how much of a certain sub-population perceive themselves as attractive.
